answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond in a shared vault before it can earn, and release it only after a trail of attested useful work. A hollow identity with no history stays locked out of rewards, while honest work slowly builds standing the way a lotus rises from still water, each verified contribution adding trust. Sybils can multiply names for free, but they cannot multiply the costly, time-bound work history the vault demands, so a thousand fake agents buys a thousand empty shells and no income.
